timing_definitions.method: docker cp this single Python module into newly created stopped experiment containers; native binaries stay intact; image and repo vLLM unchanged
timing_definitions.rx_nccl_sync_sum_ms: sum of receiver ncclRecv plus existing recv_stream.synchronize; may include peer waiting; excludes allocation and metadata gaps
timing_definitions.rx_receive_span_ms: first PUT metadata arrival to 28th synchronized receive; includes allocation and layer gaps; excludes communicator initialization before first PUT
timing_definitions.tx_nccl_sync_sum_ms: sum of sender ncclSend plus existing send_stream.synchronize
timing_definitions.tx_send_span_ms: first send_sync entry to last synchronized send; includes metadata, may overlap prefill
